as_told.title: Edgar Fouché, TR-3A/B and spinning mercury

plain: This story is about Edgar Fouché, who calls himself a whistleblower about secret aircraft, and the TR-3B, said to be a flying triangle built by copying alien technology. A researcher known as UAPGerb says on Jesse Michels' podcast that Fouché learned of the TR-3B from friends, including officials at the NSA, a US spy agency that listens in on communications. Michels tells it differently: he says Fouché claimed to have been at Area 51, a secret US military base in Nevada, and knew about TR-3A and TR-3B craft from the defence company Northrop Grumman, powered by spinning mercury. If it were true, the US would already be flying aircraft copied from something not made by humans.
